text: 1、市场早间震荡调整，创业板指盘中跌超2%。农业股逆势大涨，农发种业、京粮控股、万向德农、登海种业等十余股涨停。油气股表现活跃，石化机械涨停。下跌方面，创新药概念下挫，贝达药业跌停；光纤概念走低，金时科技跌停。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市约4000股飘绿，上午半天成交1.65万亿。午间收盘沪指跌0.39%，深成指跌1.09%，创业板跌1.3%。 2、板块概念方面，农业、猪肉、油气、乳业等板块领涨；AI应用、算力租赁、医药医疗、软件开发等板块领跌； 3、两市共1222只个股上涨，56只个股涨停；3883只个股下跌，3只个股跌停；24只股票炸板，炸板率30%。
text_en: 1. Markets saw choppy adjustments in the morning, with the ChiNext Index falling over 2% intraday. Agricultural stocks surged against the trend, with a dozen stocks including Nongfa Seed, Jingliang Holdings, Wanxiang Denong, and Denghai Seeds hitting limit-up. Oil and gas stocks were active, with Sinopec Machinery hitting limit-up. On the downside, innovative drug concepts fell, with Betta Pharma hitting limit-down; optical fiber concepts declined, with Jinshi Technology hitting limit-down. Decliners outnumbered advancers, with nearly 4,000 stocks lower across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing, and morning turnover at 1.65 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.39%, Shenzhen Component fell 1.09%, and ChiNext fell 1.3%. 2. In terms of sectors, agriculture, pork, oil and gas, and dairy led gains; AI applications, computing power leasing, healthcare, and software development led losses. 3. Across both markets, 1,222 stocks rose with 56 hitting limit-up; 3,883 fell with 3 hitting limit-down; 24 stocks broke limit-up, a failure rate of 30%.
